title: Rough Axisymmetric Euler Dynamics: Global Energy Compactness and Kinetic Passage Across Regularity Breakdown
summary: We establish global energy compactness for rough three-dimensional axisymmetric Euler flow without swirl and use it to construct hydrodynamic limits of collisional kinetic equations beyond finite-time Euler regularity breakdown. For relative vorticity in $L^1\cap L^p$, regular approximate Euler flows are globally compact in $C_tL_x^2$ for $p\ge4/3$, without a sign condition or any spatial-moment assumption.
